Inspect or await one fixed recorded session without changing it.

Usage:
  nix run .#observe -- [options]

Options:
  --slot <number>             Select a declared project slot
  --current                   Select the current recorded session once
  --run-id <id>               Select one exact bounded run identity
  --until-step <path>         Await one canonical root task step
  --wait-timeout-ms <number>  Set the positive caller-local observation timeout in milliseconds
  -h, --help                  Show this help
